learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should trigger automatic retry or fallback to another model rather than marking the entire audit as inconclusive

XML escaping instructions in prompts can cause models to enter infinite loops when encountering special characters in code snippets - consider using CDATA sections or simplifying evidence requirements
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to genuine uncertainty' in verdict reporting
When multiple models are used, a single tool error should not block a verdict if other models successfully completed the audit
